# Suspected stock-outs in the sales data (generated by code/censoring_check.py)

Sales are used as demand. A zero run (k ≥ 2 zero weeks between two sales) is flagged as a suspected stock-out when (1 − p)^k < α, p = share of weeks with a sale before the test period; α = 0.01 unless stated. The detector also flags genuine pauses in demand, so the shares are an upper-bound indication, not a measurement.

- **series**: share of evaluated series with at least one suspected run
- **weeks**: share of active series-weeks inside suspected runs
- **hidden demand**: demand those weeks would carry at the series' mean weekly rate before the test period, as a share of recorded sales
